question: The chemical reaction which involves addition of _______ or removal of ________ is called reduction.
solution:
The correct answer is __**hydrogen, oxygen.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Reduction Reaction:**

 
 
• The **chemical reaction which involves addition of hydrogen or removal of oxygen is called reduction.**
 
• The process of reduction is a type of chemical reaction in which the electron density of an atom or molecule is increased.
 
• **Reduction reactions are opposite to oxidation reactions,** which involve the loss of electrons or increase in the oxidation state of an atom or molecule.
 
• Reduction reactions are widely **used in industrial processes such as the production of metals and organic chemicals.**
 
 
 
• Redox reaction:
 
 
• Redox reactions are chemical processes involving oxidation and reduction in which the oxidation states of the reactants change.
